name: phoneimg-scraper
description: Comprehensive Smartphone Multi-Source & All-Color Image Extraction Engine

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/static', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('static/index.html', 'dist/static/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('static/index.css', 'dist/static/index.css'); fs.copyFileSync('static/app.js', 'dist/static/app.js'); fs.copyFileSync('static/index.css', 'dist/index.css'); fs.copyFileSync('static/app.js', 'dist/app.js'); console.log('Dist built successfully');"

author: Konal Pradhan
